meta.title: Travel Planner
meta.description: Plan trips with saved travel groups, trip purposes and home airports.

home.title: Travel Planner
home.tagline: Say once who you travel with and what the trip is about – every next trip builds on it.

nav.label: Main navigation
nav.demoBanner: Demo mode – data is visible to all demo visitors and is reset regularly.

errors.unknown_airport: At least one airport is unknown.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.unknown_place: This place could not be found. Please choose it again or use free text.
errors.limit_reached: You have reached the maximum number of trips. Delete one first.

login.title: Sign in
login.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
login.inviteOnly: Access is currently by invitation only.
login.linkInvalid: The sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
login.sentBody: If this address is invited, we have sent you a sign-in link and a 6-digit code.
login.codeHint: An alternative to the link, for example in the installed app.
login.codeInvalid: The code is invalid or has expired.

demo.hint: Shared demo account – what you enter is visible to other demo visitors and is reset regularly.
demo.heading: Or try it out

dashboard.tripsPlaceholder: Plan trips with your travel groups and purposes.

groups.title: Travel groups
groups.intro: Who is travelling? Everything is optional. "Several people" summarises an unnamed group, "One person" describes someone by name.
groups.entryCount: {count, plural, =0 {No entries} one {# entry} other {# entries}}
groups.name: Group name
groups.notesHint: Free text, for example preferences or special needs of the group.
groups.entriesHint: Mix both as you like. The order is the order in which you add them ("Me" always comes first).
groups.selfNoBirthdate: Your birthdate is missing in settings, so your age stays unknown.
groups.deleteBody: The group “{name}” will be deleted permanently.

entry.selfHint: Name and birthdate come from your settings.
entry.name: Name
entry.label: Label
entry.labelHint: For example parents, toddler or golfer.
entry.ageIgnored: The age is calculated from the birthdate.

groups.addMemberHelp: with a name and optional birthdate
groups.addSelfHelp: name and birthdate from your settings

traits.title: Relevant details for this group
traits.hint: Choose which details are asked for each traveller. With none selected they are omitted entirely.
traits.willBeRemoved: Values will be removed on save: {traits}.

purposes.title: Trip purposes
purposes.intro: What is the trip about? Write it freely or use the guided fields.
purposes.name: Name
purposes.textHint: Free text, for example “Golf with a friend, good food in the evening”.
purposes.guidedHint: Everything here is optional and complements the free text.
purposes.constraintsHint: For example “no flights before 9 am” or “at most 3 hours of driving”.
purposes.deleteBody: The trip purpose “{name}” will be deleted permanently.

settings.title: Settings
settings.birthdateHint: Optional. Used for your age in travel groups.

airports.label: Home airports
airports.hint: Search by name, city or code. Up to {max}, the first is preferred.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Your account and all your data will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
delete.dialogBody: All travel groups, trip purposes and settings will be lost.
delete.demoUnavailable: Not available in the demo account

trips.title: Trips
trips.intro: A trip needs only a destination and a length. Everything else is optional.
trips.retention: Up to {max} trips. A trip is deleted automatically 18 months after it ends or was last edited, whichever is later.
trips.emptyHint: Create a trip to see weather, daylight, country facts and places for your destination.
trips.deleteBody: “{name}” will be deleted permanently. Groups and purposes are kept.

detail.noPurpose: No purpose chosen. General sights are shown.
detail.flightsOff: Flights are not wanted for this trip.
detail.noAirports: No airports set. Add home airports in the settings.

destination.required: Please choose a destination or enter one as free text.
destination.searchHint: Type at least 2 characters. No match? Use your text as free text.
destination.noResults: No place found. You can use your text as free text.
destination.unavailable: Place search is unavailable right now. You can use free text.
destination.radiusHint: Weather and places are taken for this area around the place.
destination.displayNameHint: You can rename it, for example “Costa del Sol”.
destination.freeTextHint: Without a known place there is no weather, daylight or place data, only country facts if you choose a country.
destination.countryHint: Needed for country facts such as currency and language.
destination.rateLimited: Too many searches – please wait a moment. You can also enter the name as free text.

timing.noneHint: Weather is shown for all twelve months.
timing.monthsHint: Choose the months you are considering. They are alternatives, for example March or April.
timing.monthsRequired: Please choose at least one month.

form.title: Title (optional)
form.titleHint: Without a title, destination, month and length are shown.
form.groupHint: Ages are calculated for the travel date.
form.purposeHint: Interests of the purpose decide which places are suggested.

flights.title: Flights
flights.hint: Flights are verified in a later step. For now only your wish is saved.

form.notesHint: For example ship name or port list.

facts.title: Facts about the destination
facts.intro: All values come from the sources named below, never from the AI.
facts.staleHint: The source could not be reached; the last saved data is shown.

unavailable.no_location: No weather, daylight or place data for this destination.
unavailable.no_locationHint: The destination was entered as free text. Pick a place from the search to get these facts.
unavailable.no_country: No country facts for this destination.
unavailable.no_countryHint: No country is known. Choose a place or a country when editing the trip.
unavailable.not_foundHint: There is no article or entry for this place in the source.
unavailable.provider_error: The source is not reachable right now.
unavailable.provider_errorHint: Nothing is invented in its place. Please reload the page later.

weather.title: Climate
weather.intro: Average of the years {from} to {to} (reanalysis data, not a forecast).

daylight.title: Daylight
daylight.intro: Times in local time ({timezone}). “Dark from” is the end of civil twilight.
daylight.captionMid: Daylight in the middle of the month

places.title: Places to consider
places.intro: Candidates from OpenStreetMap within {radius} km, sorted by notability and distance. They are not a plan.
places.noSource: No verified source for this interest. The AI plan will suggest without facts and mark it as unverified.
places.error: The place source could not be reached. Please try again later.
places.custom: Your own interests have no verified source yet: {list}
places.morePending: More places will appear on your next visit.
places.notLoaded: More places will appear on the next visit.

sources.title: Sources and licences
sources.intro: Facts shown for a trip come from these sources. Each block names its source and the date it was checked.
sources.note: Weather data is free for non-commercial use.

open_meteo.label: Open-Meteo (ERA5 2016–2025)
open_meteo.license: CC BY 4.0. Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information.

osm.label: © OpenStreetMap contributors
osm.provides: Candidate places such as sights and golf courses.
osm.license: ODbL 1.0. The copyright page must be linked.

wikivoyage.label: Wikivoyage
wikivoyage.license: CC BY-SA 4.0. A shortened excerpt is shown with a link to the article.

rest_countries.label: Country data: mledoze/countries (ODbL)
rest_countries.provides: Country facts such as currency, language and driving side from a bundled dataset (rebuilt about yearly).
rest_countries.license: ODbL 1.0, data as of the build date.

suncalc.label: computed (suncalc)
suncalc.provides: Sunrise, sunset and twilight, calculated from coordinates and date.
